title: OTA status as the console drives it
caption: platform.tenants.status. The tenant page offers Suspend only on active and Resume only on suspended; neither in provisioning or failed. Migrate never changes the status. See also platform-api/tenant-states.

states.label: provisioning (Setting up)
states.detail: Waiting for the `provision` job. No lifecycle button.

states.label: suspended
states.detail: `suspension_reason` abuse / request / admin (console) or billing (billing sync). Buttons: **Resume**, **Migrate**.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Set-up gave up. Retry the failed `provision` job on its job page.
